searchText: Nil optional fields that precede non-nil fields need to be included in the rlp encoding. Otherwise, the decoder cannot know which fields to skip as that info isn't in the codec. This shouldn't be a problem post-fork because the "optional" capella and 4844 headers must be included anyways. So I'm not sure this is a bug per se, just a known limitation with using rlp for optional fields. Ah, so perhaps the encoder should be returning the error too? yup, it should! ok will update the issue, but won't worry about it, and just make sure the test cases either specify both or neither (Our blob tests were failing I guess because the withdrawal field wasn't getting set)

Nil optional fields that precede non-nil fields need to be included in the rlp encoding. Otherwise, the decoder cannot know which fields to skip as that info isn't in the codec.

This shouldn't be a problem post-fork because the "optional" capella and 4844 headers must be included anyways. So I'm not sure this is a bug per se, just a known limitation with using rlp for optional fields.
